Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that's all we have from this one-sided contest. New Zealand proved to be too hot to handle for Bangladesh and the tourists need to find a quick fix to their batting vulnerabilities. The second ODI is on Tuesday, 23rd March 2021, at 1400 local (0100 GMT). We look forward to your company then. Until next time, it's goodbye and cheers!

Tom Latham, the victorious New Zealand captain, says that it was a game full of debutants and milestones. He mentions about the bowling group that has been together for a while. Terms their bowling performance as clinical. On not many batsmen getting to bat, Latham smiles and says that when you win, it doesn't matter how you win and to chase down 132 in 20 odd overs was amazing. Adds that they know how destructive Guptill can be if he gets going like that. States that it was another outstanding crowd and hopes to get the same in Christchurch.

Tamim Iqbal, the skipper of Bangladesh, says that there were too many soft dismissals and they have themselves to blame and 130 on that wicket was nowhere near. Mentions that they take a lot of pride in their batting and would like to correct the mistakes. Shares that they had a good preparation so no complaints there and he doesn't want to give any excuses. Hopes to put up a better show in the next match. Talks about Mahedi Hasan and his performance and tells that he showed a lot of character in this game.

TRENT BOULT IS THE MAN OF THE MATCH! The speedster is happy that they got over the line and started the series nicely. Praises the bowlers for restricting Bangladesh to a decent total and tells that it's nice to chase down the target with only a couple of wickets down. Mentions that it is nice coming down here at the University Oval and it's nice to have a good crowd in. States that he has been here a couple of times in the last few weeks and tells that it's a nice place to bowl on and they have got some good results as well. Boult is looking forward to coming here in the next season. Further says that there were some nice words spoken when the debutants got their ODI caps and he adds that it is a happy changing room.

It was a very poor outing for Bangladesh with the bat. They put out a flavourless show where they lost wickets at regular intervals and struggled for partnerships. The conditions were challenging but not at all unplayable. There were a few positives with the ball though. Taskin Ahmed's pace troubled the Kiwi batsmen while Mahedi Hasan also bowled accurately to make run-scoring tough. Had they got enough runs on the board, they could have challenged more. Stay tuned for the presentation...

All over in the blink of an eye! A stroll in the park for the Kiwis. Bangladesh turned out to be of no match as they got steamrolled by the home team. Chasing a paltry target, New Zealand got off to a flying start courtesy of Martin Guptill's brisk knock and had he not got out, this chase would have been over even before. The rest of the work was done safely by the partnership between Henry Nicholls and Devon Conway as the Black Caps registered a thumping win. Devon though will be disappointed to throw his wicket away towards the end. With this win, New Zealand have extended their winning streak to 9 matches at this venue and also maintained their invincible record at the University Oval.

FOUR! The debutant finishes it off in style! Short ball on middle, Young pulls it to the deep square leg region for a boundary. Henry remains stranded on 49 but he won't care. NEW ZEALAND WIN BY 8 WICKETS!

FOUR! The call is for two but he gets four! Just 4 needed now! Good length ball around off, Young guides it to the third man region. The fielder comes across and tries to stop it with a dive but in vain as he ends up pushing it into the fence.
Hasan Mahmud to continue...
Full and outside off, Young plays a stylish square drive for a run. 8 needed more!
Taps a length ball down to cover-point and picks up a run.
Edgy! Full and outside off, Young looks to drive it away from his body and edges it down to third man for a single.
Angles in a length ball on top of off, Will defends it from the back foot.
Shortish and on off, Nicholls punches it through covers for a run.
Off the mark with a single! The debutant taps a back of a length ball wide of backward point. Young will feel a lot lighter.
One debutant replaces the other as Will Young comes out to bat. Also, Soumya Sarkar is into the attack now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Where has that come from? Conway has given his wicket here! Good length ball on middle, Conway uses his feet and then looks to swing it to the leg side. It takes the inner half of the bat and flies towards deep square leg where Mahmudullah runs ahead and takes the catch. Too little, too late for Bangladesh.
Back of a length ball on middle, nudged to the leg side.
FOUR! That is creamed! Brilliant from Conway! New Zealand need just 13 more! Full ball outside off, Conway creams the drive through extra cover for a boundary.
Another play and a miss! Good length ball outside off, Conway pushes inside the line and is once again beaten.
BEATEN! Back of a length ball outside off, Conway looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full on middle, Nicholls pushes it to mid off and takes a quick single. The mid off fielder hits the stumps at the bowler's end but Nicholls was in.

Another incoming delivery. Skidding in from around off, Devon tries to defend it with his bat and pad together. It goes past the inside edge and pings him on the back leg. Maybe some bat there. 18 required more.
Quicker one, skidding in from outside off, Conway blocks it with an angled bat to the off side.
Short and outside off, punched off the back foot to covers.
Once again gets forward to a full ball and pushes it to the off side. Mahedi himself makes a stop to his right.
Floated full ball on off, Conway is on the front foot in defense.
Slider on middle, the batsman moves back and turns it through square leg for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Conway shoulders arms to it.
Short ball on middle, Conway plays a controlled pull shot towards deep square leg for a couple.

FOUR! That is a lovely shot from Conway! Full ball on middle and leg, Conway eases it through the mid on region for a boundary. The mid on fielder should have dived instead of running behind the ball.
Full ball on middle, Conway defends it back to the bowler.
EDGY! On a length on middle, Nicholls looks to defend but it takes the inner half on its way to the leg side for a run.
Fullish ball on middle, Conway nudges it to deep square leg for a single.

FOUR! Misfield and a boundary for New Zealand, their first after the 10th over. Mahedi bowls it short and wide outside off, Nicholls smashes it to the left of the point fielder. Taskin runs across but fumbles while picking it up and it touches the fence. The 50-run stand comes up. 27 needed more!
Loopy and full around off, Nicholls draws forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on middle, worked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
A touch short and on middle, Conway hangs back and eases it down to long on for a run.
Skidding down the leg side, Devon tries to flick but misses and is hit high on the pads.
Flatter delivery on middle, forced down to long on for a single.

Drinks break! New Zealand are comfortably placed in the run chase! They started with a bang, with Guptill going all guns blazing. He was in a hurry but fell. But since then, Conway and Nicholls have played calmly and have got New Zealand closer to the total. Bangladesh, on the other hand, are just going through the motions and only the final rites remain for them in this game.
Loopy ball on middle, Conway defends it out.
On off, punched to covers.
Floated outside off, driven to long off for a run.
Loopy ball on middle, Devon works it down to long on for a single.
Shorter and outside off, Nicholls cuts it to deep point for a single.
Flatter ball on off, DC punches it to deep cover for a single.
Fuller and outside off, Conway forces it to long off for a run. Doing it with singles! 37 needed more.
Mahedi drags his length short and bowls it outside off, Nicholls cuts it to deep point for a single.
Too full in length on off, Devon drives it through mid off for a single.
Turning away from the batsman slightly, Conway plays late and eases it with the spin past first slip. No run as the point fielder is quick to the ball.
Short and wide outside off, Nicholls slaps it to deep point for a single.
Quicker and shorter on off, punched down towards mid on but the bowler intervened immediately with a dive.
Full on off, Nicholls pushes it down to long off for another run.
Tossed up on the pads, Conway flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter ball outside off, played to deep cover for a single.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.

Confusion but no harm done! Flighted ball outside off, Conway drives it to cover and both he and Nicholls take off for a single after seeing the fielder fumble. Slight hesitation but they eventually cross.
Mehidy Hasan is on now.
Flatter ball outside off, Nicholls punches it wide of long off for a single.
Slider on middle, on the shorter side, Henry punches it down to long on for another run. Tidy over again by Mahedi! 46 needed more for New Zealand.
Knocks a full ball down to long on for a run.
Fullish and on middle, Conway defends it back by pressing forward.
Flatter and on off, Conway hangs back and strokes it towards the bowler who deflects it to mid-wicket.
Uses his feet to come down the track, gets deceived a bit in flight and then blocks it back.
Fuller and on middle, it's flicked on the leg side but straight to mid-wicket.
Good length ball on middle, Conway looks to defend but it takes the inner half of the bat and rolls to the leg side for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Nicholls rides the bounce and works it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Full ball on off, Henry pushes it to mid off.
On a length on off, Nicholls defends it to cover.

BEATEN! Straight through! This is a great delivery from Taskin Ahmed! Full ball outside off, it nips in sharply. Nicholls looks to drive but gets cut in half as the ball goes over the stumps to the keeper.
Full on middle, Conway looks to flick but gets an inside edge which goes to mid-wicket for a run.
Quicker one, flatter and fuller on middle, Nicholls works it off his pads to mid-wicket.
Loopy and full on off, Conway is on the front foot as he drives it to long off for a run.
A back foot punch to a short ball and it goes to the cover fielder.
Flatter and on off, Conway goes on the back foot and punches it on the leg side, finds mid-wicket.
Skidding down the leg side, Devon sweeps but fails to connect well. It takes the bottom half of the bat but dies wide of the keeper.
Too full in length on middle, Conway stays back and pushes it out to covers.
Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over but we don't think this chase will last till then.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Henry Nicholls pounces on this poor ball! Short ball on middle, Nicholls pulls it to square leg where the fielder commits a misfield and the ball races into the deep square leg fence.
Outside off, left alone.
Misfield! Full ball outside off, Conway drives it crisply to cover where the fielder fumbles, allowing the batters to collect a single.
Full ball outside off, Conway watches it carefully and lets it through to Rahim.
Good length ball on off, Conway looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full ball outside off, Nicholls pushes it wide of the mid off fielder for a single.
Flatter and shorter on off, Conway goes on the back foot and punches it to covers. Good start from Mahedi.
Too full and on the pads, it's flicked past the left side of mid on for a couple of runs.
Loopy and full on off, Devon is on the front foot in defense.
Flighted and full on off, Conway strides forward and taps it down to the left of slip.
Walks down the track and tries to defend but it takes the inside half and rolls to square leg for a run.
Tossed up ball on middle, fuller in length, Nicholls pushes it down off the front foot to mid on.
Bowling change. Debutant Mahedi Hasan to bowl his offies. A slip in place...
EDGY! Fullish ball outside off, Nicholls looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge to third man for a single.13 from the over, 61 needed more.
FOUR! Thumped! Nicholls makes full use of the Free Hit! Shortish ball on middle, Nicholls clears the front leg out of the way and then heaves it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
The Free Hit will continue! Short ball around middle, Nicholls looks to pull but misses. Wide given for height but Taskin had overstepped again, so it is a No Ball.
Good length ball outside off, left alone by Henry. It's called a no ball for overstepping. Free Hit coming...
FOUR! Whipped away nicely! Full on the pads, Nicholls flicks it through the square leg region for a boundary.

Wide of the outstretched hand of the bowler. Full ball on middle, Nicholls drives it straight back towards the bowler. Taskin has his right hand stretched but it goes past him and to the deep. The batters pick up two as Mahmudullah sends it back in play.
On a length on middle and leg, Henry looks to flick but gets hit on the pads.
Full ball on off, Nicholls drives but finds the mid off fielder.
Identical to the last delivery, once again Devon allows it to come to him and then offers a dead bat in defense.
Good length ball angling into the batsman from around off, Conway defends it to the leg side with a loose bottom hand.
Fuller length ball on off, Devon presses forward and defends it to covers. This game has gone back to some normalcy after the dismissal of Guptill.
Shortish and on off, Conway stays on the back foot and defends it down right under his eyes.
Wide! Drifting down the leg side, on a good length, Conway tries to flick but misses. A flying collection by Rahim.

Superb shot! An outswinger outside off, a length delivery, Conway pushes it gently through cover-point and it races away. The fielder pulls it back before the fence and Devon is off the mark in ODIs with a couple of runs.
Pitches it up and close to off, Conway drives it through the line but finds the mid off fielder.
Extra taping for Mushfiqur Rahim.
Good length ball outside off, Nicholls lets it go to the keeper. Top over by Taskin, 3 runs and a big wicket from it.
Hurries up the batsman again with his extra pace, around leg, Henry tries to flick but misses and is thudded on the thigh pad.
Sharp delivery, at 141 kph, on a length and outside off, Conway pushes inside the line and misses. Rahim fails to grab it and has hurt his hands also. The ball deflects behind and they steal a bye.
Debutant Devon Conway comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Guptill has to go as there is a spike as the ball passed the bat. End of a terrific little inning from Guptill. He kept all of us entertained during his stay. Good length ball outside off, Guptill dances down the track and then looks to go big across the line but it seems to have taken the outside edge back to Rahim. An appeal is made and the finger has gone up. Guptill is not sure if he has hit that and consults Nicholls whether to take the review. He takes it in the end. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there is a spike. New Zealand lose a review.
Review time! Martin Guptill has taken a review as he is given out caught behind. He is not too sure that he has hit that. Ultra Edge shows that there is a spike. Guptill has to go.
Good length ball outside off, it nips back in. Guptill lets it go to the keeper. Brave leave, that was not far away from the off pole.
LEG BYE! Good length ball on the pads, Nicholls looks to flick but it goes off his pads to the leg side for a leg bye.
Wide! Taskin starts with a delivery down the leg side, Nicholls tries to flick but misses. A good take by the keeper.
Taskin Ahmed is into the attack.

SIX! It has gone miles! What a way to bring up 50 for New Zealand! Short in length and angling down the leg side, Guptill turns and pulls it massively over fine leg. It has gone out of the stadium. Only 80 needed more.
Angles in a length ball on off, Henry pushes it towards point where the fielder misfields and concedes a run.
The Fizz pulls back his length and pace and serves it outside off, Henry stands back to punch but mistimes it to cover-point.
Play and a miss! Some movement for Mustafizur. He pitches it up and wide outside off, Nicholls tries to play a booming drive but it nips away to beat the outside edge.
On and around off, a good length delivery, Nicholls gently defends it to the off side with an angled bat.
A length ball around off, Henry is on the front foot as he pushes it defensively to mid off.

SIX! Another maximum! The third man fielder thought that he had a chance but it went over. Shortish outside off, Guptill cuts it towards third man. The fielder comes across but it goes over him for a maximum. 19 from the over, New Zealand are flying!
SIX! This is some hitting from Martin Guptill! He is in the mood! Full ball on off, Guptill uses his feet to make room and then smacks it over extra cover for a maximum.
Short ball on the pads, Henry looks to help it on its way but it goes off his pads to fine leg for a leg bye.
Uppish but safe! Fullish ball outside off, Nicholls slices his attempted drive over the cover region and picks up a couple. 100 more needed.
Good length ball outside off, Nicholls leaves it alone.
FOUR! Look at the timing and the placement! Wow, just superb! Full on the pads, Nicholls just nonchalantly flicks this through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller and on off, Guptill gets on the front foot and pushes it to the off side. Straight to covers.
Uses the angle of the bowler and nurdles it to the left of mid on for a single.
Angles in a length ball on off, Nicholls defends it by getting forward.

EDGY FOUR! Good length delivery outside off, Nicholls pushes inside the line, to his credit, he played that with soft hands. It grabs the outside edge and runs wide of second slip. Third man is quite square and it's a boundary.
Two slips in place now for the left-hander.
Angling across the batsman, on a good length, Guptill plays it nice and late and guides it towards third man for a single.
Fuller length ball on middle, Guptill defends it in front of his pads.

Fullish ball on off, Guptill brings his bat down in defense and it takes the outer half. The backward point fielder dives but it sneaks past to third man and Martin retains strike with a run. 10 from this over too.
FOUR! Guptill is putting on a display of shot-making at the moment! Full ball on off, Guptill lofts it over extra cover for a boundary. Once again it drops just in front of the rope.
Good length ball on middle, Guptill looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the thigh pad.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good length ball outside off, Guptill looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.

FOUR! Guptill is in a hurry at the moment! Short ball around off, Guptill stands back and then powers it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. That almost went all the way. This is the venue that brought Guptill back to form, against Australia recently and he is looking to maximize it.
Nicholls is off the mark! Good length ball outside off, Nicholls pushes it to the deep point region for a single.
Who will bowl from the other end? Hasan Mahmud it is.

SIX! Gone the distance! Just the flick of his wrists and the timing on the shot does the rest. Fuller length delivery on middle and leg, Guptill once again picks it up and dispatches it over square leg, into the spectators sitting on the grassy banks.
FOUR! Up and over goes Guptill. That's a shot of authority. A short-arm jab! A leg stump half-volley, Guptill just picks it up and dismisses it over mid on for a boundary.
Puts it on a fuller length around off, Guptill tries to defend but gets an inside edge. It rolls to point off the pads.
Full and around off, angling away from the batsman, Martin covers his sticks and shoulders arms.
Fuller in length and close to off, Guptill crunches his drive through the line but finds the cover fielder.

Starts with a good length delivery outside off, Guptill allows it through. Just one slip in place, a bit strange. Bangladesh need wickets to win this match, they certainly can't contain the home team.
